text.p: Novartis AG said Monday its Novartis Consumer Health Inc unit has restructured its advertising accounts, eliminating four contracts and adding Ogilvy & Mather to handle media buying.

The company said its agencies of record now are Grey Advertising Inc and its Grey Healthcare unit; Jordan, McGrath, Case & Taylor; NCI Masterson; the Seidon Group; and TWBA/Chiat Day, a unit of Omnicom Group Inc.
The international pharaceutical giant said it has terminated contracts with Robert Becker Inc; NCI Advertising; Publicis/Bloom, a unit of Publicis SA ; and the Sawtooth Group.
Novartis' two predecessor companies -- Ciba-Geigy AG CIGZ.S and Sandoz AG SANZ.S -- worked previously with Ogilvy & Mather, a unit of WPP Group Plc, Novartis said.
The review began after Novartis AG was created in the December 1999 merger of the two Swiss rivals, the company said.
